title: continuous-regression-result.v1
description: Project Spec S0226: strict persisted schema for a governed internal continuous-regression runtime prediction result. Mirrors contracts/multiclass-classification-result.schema.json's shape discipline for the S0223/S0225 continuous-regression semantics -- a single finite numeric predicted_value plus the governed model_descriptor. Never defines a class, a probability, a threshold, a decision strategy, an interpretation/risk band, a confidence field, a unit, a confidence/prediction interval, a residual, or a multi-output value -- those remain out of scope. Standard JSON Schema numeric validation does not by itself reject non-finite Python floats (NaN/Infinity); runtime code must separately enforce math.isfinite(predicted_value) before this schema is used.

predicted_value.description: Finite numeric runtime prediction. Never rounded, bucketed, or dataset-unit-labeled by this contract.

model_family.description: Bounded to the Project Spec S0224/S0225/S0232 Atlas-native fixed-configuration continuous-regression model families -- continuous regression has no external fitted-model source.
